**Glassify** is Spotify on Windows, your way: see-through glass in your own colours, a player that folds into a small card or a bar on the edge of your screen, and out of the way the moment you start a game. It runs Spotify's own web player, so your library and Premium work as usual. Website: https://ilyvbrdn.github.io/Glassify/

## Download and run
1. Download **Glassify-v1.1.zip** below.
2. Extract it to a folder you can write to (Documents, Downloads...). Not Program Files.
3. Run `Glassify.exe` and sign in to Spotify (Premium needed).

First launch only: if Windows shows *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info → Run anyway**. The app isn't code-signed yet. After that, Glassify updates itself.

Already have Glassify? It installs this update by itself (or click the download arrow at the top right).

## New in 1.1
- **The × closes into your player.** With "Minimize or close to the player" on, the – and × buttons leave the mini player or bar playing. Quit from the Glassify icon by the clock (or Alt+F4).
- **Updates install themselves**, a few seconds after starting and every 2 hours, with your music still playing (never during a game). Can be switched off in Settings > More.
- **The Now playing panel follows your look.** It used to stay black in every look (and was hard to read in Light); now it shows your glass, colour or gradient like the other panels.
- **Gradient panels**: two colours, any angle, a balance slider; the search box, mini player and bar follow it.
- **Settings in tabs**: Look, Player, Gaming, More.
- **Simpler Look slider**: Glass, Solid, Light. Light is as light as it gets.
- **Sturdier bar menu**: search and play work even when Spotify's page is slow to draw.
- **Fixes**: the window could start cut off on screens with display scaling; minimizing could make Glassify look closed; the search box was hard to read on light colours.

## What's in it
- Looks: Glass, Solid and Light, with your own panel colour or two-colour gradient, transparency, highlight colour and an optional glass top bar
- One player, two shapes: a resizable always-on-top mini player, or a bar docked to any edge of any screen with next in queue, recent playlists, your library and song search
- Minimize or close to the player (tray icon shows it's still running)
- Automatic game mode: switches to the player and low priority when a fullscreen game starts (browsers, videos and screenshot tools are ignored)
- Click-through "ghost" mini player while gaming (Ctrl+Alt+G)
- Hotkeys: Ctrl+Alt+M player, Ctrl+Alt+B mini player ↔ bar, Ctrl+Alt+L like, Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down volume, media keys
- Optional song-change popup and start with Windows
- Crash recovery and automatic updates

## Requirements
Windows 10 or 11 with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (built into Windows 11) and a Spotify Premium account.

Not affiliated with Spotify. Glassify runs Spotify's official web player unmodified and only changes the look and the window.
